projects.title: Spectral classification & model evaluation
projects.description: Developed preprocessing, feature-extraction, and evaluation pipelines for approximately 5,000 Raman/SERS spectra across four cancer cell lines.

projects.evidence: Reported 95% classification accuracy on this research dataset; evaluated with ROC/AUC and confusion matrices.
